revision_note: v2.1: 依据两个 validator 的 26+17 项检查修复。关键修复: 删除 Gödel 机器论文中虚构的 2017 年引用链; 自主度分级由 L1-L5 改名为 A1-A5 以与参考架构 L1-L7 分离命名空间; 文献计数 70->73; 为容量定理补 i.i.d./PAC 前提; 软化 5 处绝对断言; 补 4 条排除清单与 RQGM 归档规则; 修正 Part 3/4/5 残留章节编号.
revision_note_en: v2.1: fixes from two validators (26 + 17 findings). Key: removed a fabricated 2017 citation chain from the Gödel machine section; renamed autonomy levels L1-L5 to A1-A5 to separate the namespace from the reference architecture's L1-L7; reference count 70 to 73; added the i.i.d./PAC preconditions to the capacity theorem; softened 5 absolute claims; added the 4-item exclusion list and RQGM archiving rule; corrected leftover subsection numbering in Parts 3/4/5.
author: Hermes 主 agent + 检索 subagent + validator subagent
description: RSI(递归自我改进)与 Self-Evolution(自进化)的 2025-2026 全景综述. v2 重构为七章递进: (0) 可证伪的三条件定义(自写/外部验证/递归保持) + L1-L5 分级 + 搜索三元组(S,V,A); (1) 三学术共同体的坐标 + 学习理论的容量边界定理 + 验证器 V-1~V-5 分档; (2) 七层参考架构及 AlphaEvolve/DGM/RQGM 逐层对照; (3) 工业格局; (4) 技术路线与算力经济学; (5) 挑战与安全护栏. 全文中英双语并行.
description_en: A 2025-2026 panorama of RSI and self-evolution, rebuilt in v2 as a seven-chapter progression: (0) a falsifiable three-condition definition plus L1-L5 levels and the search triplet (S,V,A); (1) the three academic communities, the learning-theoretic capacity bound and the V-1..V-5 verifier tiers; (2) a seven-layer reference architecture with a layer-by-layer comparison of AlphaEvolve, DGM and RQGM; (3) industry; (4) technical routes and compute economics; (5) challenges and guardrails. Bilingual throughout.
